global_issues.title: US-Iran War Escalation Drives Oil Above $97
global_issues.note: Multiple independent sources (stock market recaps, TradingEconomics) place WTI around $89-92/bbl and Brent around $95/bbl on 2026-09-01/02, not WTI above $97. The US-Iran escalation and Hormuz disruption narrative is accurate, but the specific $97 WTI figure appears inflated/incorrect — possibly conflating Brent with WTI or an intraday spike not sustained at close.

global_issues.title: US 10-Year Yield Hits Highest Since 2023 Amid Bond Rout
global_issues.note: Confirmed by CNBC and Yahoo Finance: 10-year Treasury yield hit ~4.814% intraday on 2026-09-02, highest since November 2023, driven by inflation fears tied to oil and expectations of rate hikes. Note: by close on 9/2, yields 'took a breather' and equities rallied, so the rout was easing by end of day rather than accelerating as the briefing implies.

grok_report.summary: The 10-year yield story is accurate and well-sourced, but the oil price figure (WTI >$97) appears materially overstated versus independently reported ~$90 WTI/~$95 Brent. More importantly, the briefing misses the day's biggest NVDA-specific catalyst (near-$14B Hugging Face acquisition report) and its cautious 'yellow' market mood conflicts with the actual same-day rally that snapped a three-day losing streak across major indices.
